title: Sugarlang Curriculum Band
description: One CEFR band of the authored curriculum: its lessons and the competencies in them. Language-neutral -- the phrases that realize a competency live with a language's own data.

band.description: The CEFR band every competency in this file belongs to.

lessons.description: Topics within the band. A lesson is what a situation can match -- a cafe is food, a ticket window is transport.

ordinal.description: Position within the band. `A1.5` is band plus ordinal, derived and never stored, so renumbering does not edit text other things parse.

competencyId.description: Stable slug, and what the Teacher reads -- the prompt drops the descriptors at this scale, so the id has to say what the competency is on its own. PERMANENT once shipped: learner cards and teach records are written against it.

lessonId.description: The lesson this belongs to. Exactly one.

cefrDescriptor.description: The can-do statement, in the CEFR's own voice.

isItemZero.description: Taught before anything else, regardless of level. Repair language a beginner needs to survive turn two.

placementGateBand.description: When set, taught before the learner is placed rather than waiting on assessment.

interpretLexiconCategory.description: Feeds this competency's phrases to social-move detection, so a player typing one is recognized as performing it.
